question.question: When and at what VP can you activate dominance, what wins each suit, and can an activated card be replaced or discarded?

expected.expected_answer: During own Daylight at least 10 VP, put card in play area, remove score marker, no longer score VP. Mouse/rabbit/fox win ruling three matching clearings at start of own Birdsong; bird wins ruling two opposite corner clearings then. Activated card cannot be removed or replaced.

source_passages.quotation: **Dominance (3.3):** In own Daylight at **at least 10 VP**, activate a dominance card from hand into play area; remove score marker and stop scoring VP. Cannot remove/replace activated card. At **start of own Birdsong**, win if ruling **three clearings of matching mouse/rabbit/fox suit**, or for **bird dominance, two diagonally opposite corner clearings**. Meeting condition earlier does not immediately win. Dominance cards cannot be crafted, but can be spent for suit. Whenever one would enter discard, put it near map available instead. During own Daylight, spend matching card to take available dominance into hand. Available **bird dominance remains bird**, so payment must be bird; a bird hand card can pay for non-bird dominance. Activation and taking are separate, neither requires a faction action allowance.

answer.ruling: During your own Daylight, at 10 or more VP, activate a dominance card from hand into your play area. Remove your score marker and stop scoring VP.

At the start of your own Birdsong, win by ruling three clearings of the dominance card's matching mouse, rabbit or fox suit; with bird dominance, rule two diagonally opposite corner clearings. Meeting the condition earlier does not win immediately.
The activated dominance card cannot be removed or replaced. Any dominance card that would enter the discard pile is instead placed near the map as available.
